INFORMED, NOT COUNTED (thresholds.counting: its test ran before this prereg). regressions.claim: I58 changes no output of M0-M4 and no generator closure: holon.metrics.compute renders M0-M3's committed results/<M>/metrics.json byte for byte, holon.records.generator_files names neither holon/m5 nor holon/metrics.py for any IR version, no frozen file changes (tools/freeze.py check: FROZEN OK), and I58's own commits touch no path under results/M0-M4, gen/M0-M4, laws/M0-M4 or replay/.

The M5 iterations' outputs are unchanged on the merged tree: python -m holon m5 prereg|controls|census|l9 --check, m5 metrics --base --check, intent metrics --check, intent corpus-score --check and games corpus --check all print CHECK OK.

The M5 keys' counted predictions, as their iteration reports record them: I54 1 of 3 held, I54b 4 of 5, I55 10 of 11, I55b 2 of 3, I56 2 of 5, I56b none, I57 5 of 5 counted (its 2 informed ones held): 24 of 32 counted predictions held, 8 missed.

thresholds.base: claude/i57-m5-environment-modules at f8842357 (PR #147), with claude/i55-m5-intent (2d8f42a1, #138), claude/i56-m5-games (d3af7179, #139) and claude/i54b-m5-truth-key (d4a09349, #136) merged in as merge commits; all stacked on claude/i54-m5-definitions (#134)
thresholds.measured_by: I54 definitions (spec/M5/preregistration.json) through holon.m5.metrics, unchanged; I56's V9 wrapper (holon.games.metric.l6_v9) for L6
thresholds.metrics_path: results/M5/metrics.json: I54's definitions name no path, so the milestone's metrics file (holon.metrics, which holon land regenerates) carries L6, L9 and L10 beside its section-13 block
thresholds.report_path: docs/M5_REPORT.md, generated by python -m holon m5 report and checked by its --check

rules.never_round_up: a measure labelled insufficient_n or not_measured is never judged; each metric's overall is common.overall of its thresholds, and the report prints it verbatim; the generator refuses a document in which any of this fails
rules.no_pooling: constructed truth (controls) and documented truth (corpus, history) are reported apart; I55's pooled precision is not reported
rules.pins: every truth file a metric reads is reported with its sha256, and the generator refuses unless it equals the measuring key's pin
rules.agreement: the generator refuses unless each metric equals the measuring iteration's committed output
rules.evidence: a condition or limitation is printed only when every evidence check in spec/M5/lib/I58_report.json holds

informed.why: each metric's status is already recorded in the measuring iteration's committed outputs (results/M5/corpus/l6_corpus.json, results/M5/l9_I57.json, results/M5/intent/l10.json and intent/corpus/l10_corpus.json), which the builder read before this prereg, and the builder ran the iterations' --check commands on the merged tree; BUILD_PLAN 0.1 counts only claims whose outcome is recorded nowhere; I58-P7: one run of the then-red contract tests, before this prereg commit, executed test_p7_v4_independent, which needs no holon output, and it passed. The runs of test_p5 and test_p6 computed the reference but stopped at the missing results/M5/metrics.json, so their outcomes were not seen (disclosed as BUILD_PLAN 0.1's undetectable-local-run risk)
